review_candidates.title: Network & Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Network & Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for maintaining secure and reliable connectivity for the entire enterprise, covering data centres, office locations, and cloud services. This position works closely with the Cloud Engineering team to align on network, server, and connectivity requirements as services migrate to Azure. Responsibilities Network Infrastructure Management: Manage 7IM’s internal and external networks, including office/data centre LANs, WAN, Wi-Fi, and Azure cloud.
eligibility_evidence: It also drives projects that improve resilience, security, and performance as 7IM continues its transformation towards a hybrid cloud model.

About You Knowledge Networking & Cloud: Strong grasp of networking principles for on-premises and cloud setups, especially Microsoft Azure features like Virtual Networks, VPNs, firewalls, and hybrid architecture.
Hands-on experience with both on-premises infrastructure and cloud-based services is highly desirable, reflecting the hybrid nature of 7IM’s environment.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This position works closely with the Cloud Engineering team to align on network, server, and connectivity requirements as services migrate to Azure. Aware of the importance of compliance, data protection, and risk management in delivering technology services in line with business and regulatory requirements. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience). Hands-on experience with both on-premises infrastructure and cloud-based services is highly desirable, reflecting the hybrid nature of 7IM’s environment. Professional certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP or CompTIA Network+ are desirable, demonstrating solid networking expertise.

review_candidates.title: Senior System Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Per realtà manifatturiera internazionale, leader nel proprio settore e caratterizzata da una forte attenzione all’innovazione tecnologica, ricerchiamo un/a Senior System Administrator. Attività: Amministrazione e supporto dell’infrastruttura IT on-premise e cloud; Gestione e manutenzione degli ambienti Microsoft 365 e dei relativi servizi; Amministrazione di sistemi di virtualizzazione VMware; Gestione dell’infrastruttura di rete e dei sistemi di sicurezza perimetrale; Monitoraggio, manutenzione
